discipline: Registered before scoring. Based on poson_law invariants and UniProt protein states only. alpha_scale/empirical_series are excluded as a basis: across the 3,000 core datasets the empirical slope is ~1.57*alpha_scale for every law (corr ~0.99), a shared template, so alpha-derived predictions would be circular. Negative predictions falsify mechanism assignments. No row may be edited after registration except to fill status/scored_on/outcome.

predictions.prediction: BMP patterning in the zebrafish gastrula is NOT free differential diffusion of BMP vs Chordin: Chordin's effective mobility in the embryo will exceed the free-diffusion size prior, because transport is by Chordin shuttling + tolloid release.
predictions.quantitative_expectation: Free-diffusion prior from protein states: D_chordin/D_mature-BMP2b = 0.51 (921 aa vs 122 aa, D~MW^-1/3), which violates the Turing requirement D_inhibitor/D_activator > 1. Prediction: measured effective BMP-gradient formation will behave as if the ratio is >= 1 (shuttling), never as 0.51 free diffusion.
basis: datasets/danio_rerio_turing_wavelength/protein_states.json: activator_inhibitor_size_check
UniProt O57472 (chordin, tolloid-cleavage PTM comment) / O93369 (bmp2b)
predictions.falsifier: Direct mobility measurements (e.g. FRAP of tagged BMP/Chordin in gastrula) showing both species freely diffusing with D ratio ~0.5 AND normal dorsoventral patterning.
predictions.test_source: ZFIN chordin (dino) / tolloid (minifin) phenotypes; published pSmad1/5 gradient measurements in zebrafish gastrula

resolvability.why: Datasets give the protein states and the 0.51 size prior; deciding needs published mobility/pSmad data, which exist but must be extracted.
resolvability.resolution_route: Extract FRAP / pSmad-gradient evidence from zebrafish gastrula literature; compare effective D ratio to the 0.51 free-diffusion prior.
resolvability.actual_verdict_note: as_predicted — current_plus_public_sources (conf 0.60): public literature decided it; repo alone could only state the prior.

scoring.note: Outcome score and resolvability score are independent: a confirmed biology prediction can still refute a meta-resolvability forecast (see META-RES-02/03, refuted because ZF-HH-01 resolved only partially, making 9 fully decided and 5 partial).
